hints.setup: Start in the full source root. Replace the example path. Choose fresh environments; conda uses explicit prefixes. These commands select the CPU pathology route by default.
hints.data: Obtain the permitted PolypGen archive and replace its local path. The CAMELYON command downloads the pinned community redistribution. Image hashes must match the canonical manifests.
hints.features: Run environment setup and stage both real-image cohorts first. UNI/CONCH need provider approval and interactive local login. Keep CBMP_FEATURE_DIR unchanged. See the full guide for the optional GPU choice.
hints.fit: Run after preparing all five feature sets. Planning validates inputs; the second command actually fits/selects the heads. Expected: 50 task/seed jobs and 3,080 target/head/seed metric cells.
hints.report: Run only after the complete ten-seed study. These commands recompute metrics from predictions, audit group uncertainty/stability and export tables. Use fresh report/export directories.
